structured_output.what_is_happening: A Chinese-named copycat "超级智能 / Super Intelligence" token went up about 8x in 2 hours, to roughly $95k market cap. It launched directly on PumpSwap (not a pump.fun contract address, launchpad unknown), and the dev seeded about $68k of liquidity, all of it unlocked. The narrative is borrowed: at the UN, Trump said AI should be renamed "Super Intelligence", and the canonical play on that is Super Inu (SI), which peaked at about $10M (per KuCoin/ChainCatcher). This coin has no socials, website or description. Its trading looks manufactured. In the last hour about 99 unique buyers and 99 unique sellers made about 2,255 trades between them (about 11 per wallet), for $900k of volume on a $90k market cap. Over 6h there were 2,109 unique buyers but only 104 unique sellers. At least six other "超级智能" copies launched in the last few hours now have $0 of liquidity, so they were already pulled or dead.

narrative.description: Trump's UNGA remark renaming AI 'Super Intelligence' triggered a wave of SI / Super Intelligence memecoins on Solana. The leading one, Super Inu (SI), reached about $10M.
narrative.why_spreading: A real news hook from about 1-2 days ago. But the canonical token (Super Inu) already took the attention, and a flood of same-name copies (including many Chinese-named ones) points to a farmed ticker, not organic spread.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is just one of many Chinese-named copies of the Super Intelligence meme. Nothing ties it to the story or to any community beyond the name.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Super Inu / SI (canonical, about $8M, launched on Stonk). Other SI Super Intelligence tokens: AF31… ($350k), 9LUf…pump ($220k), 82ez…pump ($158k). Chinese-named copies with $0 liquidity: BDnp…, 5sxK…, 8zBd…, E18N…, E9ZD…, C2dr…

authenticity.evidence: Last hour: about 99 buyers and 99 sellers made about 2,255 trades, and turnover was 13.7x market cap. Only 104 unique sellers against 2,109 buyers over 6h, which fits holder-inflation dust buys plus a small set of wallets doing the trading. GMGN flags 8 bundler wallets. The same-name Chinese copies in the last few hours now have zero liquidity (serial launches). There are no socials. Nothing about this contract turned up on the web.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see X or private Telegram. Chinese-language call groups might be pushing it for real.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on a self-seeded PumpSwap pool, so the dev can pull liquidity at any time
Several same-name copies from the last few hours already sit at $0 liquidity, which suggests serial launch-and-pull
Volume looks like wash trading (about 11 trades per wallet per hour)
Creator account shows creator_close; no socials

structured_output.counterargument: Momentum is extreme (+36% in 5 minutes, +400% in 1 hour) and the Super Intelligence theme is still hot after Trump's speech. The top-10 holder share excluding the pool is a modest 18%, mint and freeze authority are renounced, and liquidity is deep relative to market cap. A move from $95k to $190k needs only one more leg of wash-driven momentum, which could happen before any pull.
unknowns: X and Telegram activity for the Chinese ticker
Whether the dev behind this coin also launched the copies that now have $0 liquidity

source_coverage.notes: Contract search returned nothing relevant. News coverage covers only the canonical Super Inu/SI and Trump's remark. The packet lists no project links. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not searched separately because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: This is a late, non-canonical Chinese copy of a meme that has already peaked. The volume looks manufactured, the self-seeded LP is fully unlocked, and several sibling copies from the last few hours already have zero liquidity. Rug risk is high and the chance of a runner is low, even though momentum is strong.
